title: First-episode psychosis: history
stem: Cubicle 12. Kelvin, 20, a university student, was brought by his sister. For two months he has stopped attending classes, stays in his room, and says his neighbours are spying on him through the walls. Take a history to assess for psychosis and risk.
notes:
Checked against NICE CG178 (Psychosis and schizophrenia in adults, 2014) and CG155 (children and young people), and the Hong Kong EASY (Early Assessment Service for Young people with early psychosis) programme.

History: positive symptoms (delusions, hallucinations, thought interference — insertion, withdrawal, broadcasting — passivity), negative symptoms (withdrawal, apathy, poverty of speech, blunting), disorganisation, duration, triggers, substance use (cannabis, stimulants), mood symptoms (to separate schizoaffective and psychotic mood disorders), medical causes, family history, risk (to self, others, self-neglect, vulnerability), insight. Investigations exclude organic causes (drugs, thyroid, glucose, infection; neuroimaging if atypical). Refer urgently to early intervention in psychosis (EASY in HK) — shorter duration of untreated psychosis improves outcome.

Your notes list psychosis history as a topic and have MSE descriptions (auditory hallucinations → schizophrenia; tangential, blocking); nothing conflicts.

steps.label: Talk to Kelvin
steps.hint: Rapport, beliefs, voices, thought interference, mood, substances, risk, insight.

Beliefs.t: How have things been at home lately?
Beliefs.rz: 唔安全。啲鄰居喺牆度鑽窿偷聽。佢哋知道我諗緊乜。
Beliefs.r: Not safe. The neighbours drill holes and listen. They know my thoughts.
Beliefs.mark: Opens neutrally and elicits persecutory beliefs

Beliefs.t: How do you know they're watching you?
Beliefs.rz: 樓下嗰架紅色車就代表佢哋舉報咗我。好明顯啦。
Beliefs.r: The red car outside means they've reported me. It's obvious.
Beliefs.mark: Explores the basis of the belief (delusional perception)

Beliefs.t: Do thoughts ever get put into your head or taken out, or broadcast to others?
Beliefs.tz: 有冇覺得有啲諗法俾人放入你個腦、俾人拎走，或者俾其他人聽到？
Beliefs.rz: 佢哋將我諗嘅嘢廣播出去。成個港鐵嘅人都聽到。
Beliefs.r: They broadcast my thoughts. Everyone on the MTR hears them.

Perception.t: Do you hear voices when no one is around?
Perception.tz: 冇人喺度嗰陣，你會唔會聽到有人講嘢？
Perception.rz: 有兩個男人講我：「佢冇用㗎，佢係間諜。」
Perception.r: Two men talk about me: 'he's useless, he's a spy'.

Mood and substances.rz: 好驚，唔係唔開心。我日頭先瞓。
Mood and substances.r: Scared, not sad. I sleep in the day.

Mood and substances.tz: 有冇食大麻、冰，或者飲酒？
Mood and substances.rz: 舊年差唔多每個週末都食大麻。

Risk.t: Have you thought about hurting yourself, or the neighbours?
Risk.tz: 你有冇諗過傷害自己，或者傷害啲鄰居？
Risk.rz: 有時諗過了結自己，等佢哋捉唔到我。我買咗把刀防身。
Risk.r: Sometimes I think of ending it so they can't get me. I bought a knife for protection.
Risk.mark: Assesses risk to self and others including weapons

Risk.t: Do you think this could be an illness?
Risk.tz: 你覺唔覺得呢啲可能係一種病？

steps.label: Talk to his sister
steps.hint: Change from his usual self, duration, family history, function.

Collateral.t: How is he different from usual?
Collateral.rz: 佢以前讀書好叻。而家唔沖涼，差唔多唔講嘢，仲用錫紙封住晒啲窗。
Collateral.r: He was a top student. Now doesn't wash, barely speaks, covers the windows with foil.
Collateral.mark: Collateral on functional decline and negative symptoms

Collateral.t: Any family history of mental illness?
Collateral.tz: 屋企人有冇人有精神病？

steps.label: Summarise
steps.hint: Likely diagnosis, differentials, risk, investigations, referral.

opts.t: First-episode psychosis, likely schizophrenia: persecutory delusions, thought broadcasting, third-person voices, negative symptoms for 2 months
opts.mark: Summarises and gives the likely diagnosis

opts.t: Differentials: substance-induced psychosis, mood disorder with psychosis, organic causes
Risk: suicidal thoughts and a knife — urgent psychiatric assessment today; remove the weapon; admission likely
opts.mark: Identifies high risk and plans urgent assessment

opts.t: Bloods, urine drug screen, TFT; early intervention service (EASY)
opts.mark: Organic screen and early intervention referral

wrong: Pressured speech, grandiosity and reduced sleep
EASY is a legal requirement for all new psychosis
To avoid starting antipsychotic medication early

qs.q: Drug that increases psychosis risk in youth?

qs.a: A real perception given a sudden delusional meaning
wrong: A hallucination in any sensory modality
An illusion from misreading a real object
A vivid dream remembered as real

badge.name: Reality Check
badge.flavor: Positive, negative, substances, mood, risk, early intervention.

cards.why: Early Assessment Service for Young people with early psychosis.

cards.q: Organic screen in first-episode psychosis includes…
options: Lipase and amylase only, for pancreatitis

cards.q: Most important risk question when psychotic and fearful?
options: Weapons and intent to harm self or others
Family history of schizophrenia in first-degree relatives
A fixed false belief not shared by culture
